module_summary: Credit-based request throttle: an up/down credit counter tracks outstanding requests and gates request valid/ready pass-through when the credit limit is reached.

anchors.name: credit_q
anchors.why: Outstanding-request counter; increments on request handshake, decrements on response handshake.

anchors.name: credit_available
anchors.why: Compares counter to credit limit; gates both req_valid_o and req_ready_o.

anchors.name: req_valid_o
anchors.why: Throttled request valid passed downstream only when credit available.

anchors.name: req_ready_o
anchors.why: Throttled ready returned upstream only when credit available.

anchors.name: rsp_valid_i
anchors.why: Response valid; with rsp_ready_i decrements the credit counter.

anchors.name: rsp_ready_i
anchors.why: Response ready; qualifies response handshake for counter decrement.

anchors.name: credit_i
anchors.why: Configured maximum number of outstanding transfers compared against counter.

groups.name: credit_counter
groups.description: Up/down credit counter and limit comparison producing credit_available.

groups.name: request_gate
groups.description: Gates request valid and ready with credit availability.

groups.name: response_monitor
groups.description: Observes response handshakes to return credit.
